input.quote: This Agreement shall renew automatically thereafter for successive one year periods until terminated pursuant to Section 12 herein or unless either Client or TrueLink deliver to the other written notice of intent not to renew no later than thirty (30) days prior to the end of said year.
input.rationale: Section 13 (p0078) provides automatic successive one-year renewals which either party may stop by written notice of intent not to renew 30 days before the end of the year, so the notice window sits inside the 60-day fallback ceiling; our insertion confirms that 30-day figure in operative language without altering the existing mechanic, expressly "under this Section 13" so it creates no second independent covenant. The substantive gap is renewal pricing: Section 6 (p0047) freezes Hosting Services costs only "for a period of one year from the date of this Agreement", leaving every renewal term repriceable without limit and failing the fallback 5% ceiling. One short sentence carries both fallback elements and nothing more. Retained mechanics are unchanged: the Section 6 first-year freeze and most-favoured-rate covenant, the Section 2/3 early-termination provisos, the Section 12 termination cross-reference and the 30/60-day name-server and hosting-migration timelines; confining the cap to "any renewal term" avoids any conflict with the first-year freeze. The cap reads on TrueLink's fees generally rather than only Hosting Services fees, which favours Client. Preferred wording is not pressed: there is no TrueLink reminder 60 days before renewal and the cap is a flat 5% rather than the lesser of CPI and 3%.

mappings.element: If renewal is automatic, Customer's non-renewal notice window is no more than 60 days.
If renewal permits price increases, each increase is capped at 5 percent.

proposal.summary: Confirm 30 days' non-renewal notice and cap renewal fee increases at 5%
proposal.comment: [Playbook] Section 6 freezes pricing only for the first year, so renewal terms could reprice without limit; we have added our fallback 5% cap on fee increases in any renewal term and confirmed that the non-renewal notice window under Section 13 is 30 days.

ops.text: For clarity, Client's non-renewal notice window under this Section 13 is 30 days, and TrueLink's fees will not increase by more than five percent (5%) in any renewal term.
